headline: President Lee Jae Myung Nominates New Cabinet Ministers In South Korea
seoTitle: Lee Jae Myung Nominates New Cabinet Ministers
metaDescription: President Lee Jae Myung has nominated Han Jun-ho as interior minister and Hong Ihk-pyo as unification minister, reshuffling the South Korean cabinet.
aiSummaryBullets: Han Jun-ho, a Democratic Party lawmaker and close ally of the president, has been nominated for the position of interior and safety minister.
Veteran policymaker Hong Ihk-pyo was tapped to serve as the new unification minister following his role as senior presidential secretary.
The nominations represent a shift in the ministerial cabinet under the current administration of President Lee Jae Myung.
aiContextParagraph: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has announced significant changes to his cabinet by nominating two key political figures to ministerial posts. Han Jun-ho, a Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker and long-time political ally, has been selected as the minister of the interior and safety. Han previously worked in the presidential office during the Moon Jae-in administration and served as a senior aide for Lee's 2022 presidential campaign. Additionally, Hong Ihk-pyo, a former three-term lawmaker and established party policymaker, has been nominated as the unification minister. Hong recently concluded a tenure as senior presidential secretary for political affairs under President Lee, a position he held from January 2026 until early November 2026. These appointments reflect ongoing personnel adjustments within the executive branch as the administration navigates domestic policy and regional relations on the Korean Peninsula.
whyItIsViral: The nominations are considered a notable political development, having been reported by multiple major news outlets and tracking steadily in regional coverage.
